accessrestrict.head: Conditions Governing Access
accessrestrict.p: Open for research. Brittle or damaged items are available at the discretion of RAC.

processinfo.head: Processing Information
processinfo.p: Expedited Access - Processing Level 1 - File-Level Access.
Records remain in original housing. Additional processing will be conducted in the future to improve description, enhance access, and long-term preservation.

userestrict.head: Conditions Governing Use
userestrict.p: The Rockefeller Archive Center has title, copyright, and literary rights in the collection, in so far as it holds them, and has authority to grant permission to cite and publish archival material from the collection.

acqinfo.head: Immediate Source of Acquisition
acqinfo.p: Mary Brown Bullock donated her papers to RAC in 2019 and the records were transferred to the Archive Center with several associated accretions.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: The Mary Brown Bullock papers document her work and career in Chinese history and relations including but not limited to the China Medical Board of New York, the Peking Union Medical College, Chinese Academy of Medical Sciences, the Rockefeller Foundation, and the National Committee on United States-China Relations.

Records include working papers, journals, publications, correspondence, interviews, reports, draft articles and proposals, as well as documentation of her dissertation and publications and associated correspondence.
